semantics.inputUnshuffle: torch.nn.PixelUnshuffle(2); channel = c * r*r + i * r + j
semantics.outputShuffle: torch.nn.PixelShuffle(4); channel = c * r*r + i * r + j
semantics.headConv: Conv2d(12, F, 3, padding=1) zero padding, no activation
semantics.resBlock: expand 1x1 -> pad 1px with expand bias per channel -> fea 3x3 padding=0 + pre-pad identity -> reduce 1x1 -> += block input; no activation inside
semantics.bodyBlock: LayerNorm2d -> ResBlock -> activation; block-level residual disabled (residual=False)
semantics.layerNorm2d: mean/var over the channel dim, eps=1e-6, then weight*y + bias
semantics.highFrequencyBranch: gaussian blur, hfb and gamma are dead at inference because forget=False
